product_launches.description: Basatne, via its consumer brand Cartlow, launched the GCC’s first subscription-based, multi-seller circular retail platform, replacing per-transaction commissions with a flat monthly fee for sellers.

press_references.value: Cartlow unveils region’s first commission-free circular subscription platform

product_launches.description: Cartlow has launched the region's first commission-free circular subscription platform, promoting sustainability and the circular economy in the MENA region.

overview_description.description: Our approach enables and structures a new circular commerce market through scalable circular practices. We lead the green-tech revolution in the GCC with an integrated Circular Economy Closed-loop ecosystem. Our innovative solutions include advanced cloud-based reverse logistics management, buyback & trade-in programs, comprehensive diagnostics & data wiping, IT Asset Disposition (ITAD) Programs, and a multi-seller recommerce channel.
